name: HONOR Robot Phone (MWC promotional estimate)
status: estimated prelaunch promotional design; not OEM CAD

accuracy.body_dimensions: 76.5 x 163.8 x 8.9 mm is an estimated scale, not a published measurement. HONOR global spec page had empty dimension values on 2026-10-23.
accuracy.screen_geometry: 71.48 x 156 mm opening, 6.1 mm corners and 1260 x 2750 texture canvas are estimates, not confirmed panel size or native resolution.
accuracy.camera_geometry: Reconstruction of MWC promotional TVC and transparent gimbal render. Top-edge flip anchor, pan base, dogleg side bracket, pitch motor and optical-axis roll stay connected. A recessed rear pocket accommodates the stowed mechanism inside the chassis. Link lengths, hidden axes, cavity depth, bump depths and motor internals are estimated; not OEM CAD.
accuracy.motion: Stowed rear-facing camera swings outward behind body before rising above top edge. Head faces display side when deployed. Shutter clears before flip; tracking angles return to neutral for stow. Timing and clearances are illustrative.
accuracy.branding: HONOR vector outline from Documents brand_logos.json; lower rear placement/size estimated from collection icon. Finish-aware tones use make_device_branding.tone/apply. MWC footage also shows an alpha symbol, omitted to preserve requested collection HONOR branding.
accuracy.finishes: Black/White collection names and existing swatches; approximate reflective arm/rail and satin rear, not calibrated materials.
accuracy.omissions: Hidden actuator gearing, flex cables, seals, production camera specifications, ports and tiny inscriptions omitted. Promotional reference differs from subsequent commercial product; this profile deliberately describes the MWC design.
